messages.author: 3d5c753ab9984eeb
messages.subject: simple use of gmultmix
parts:
Hi
I'm a beginner with unmarked and could use some help to get up to
speed. I'm trying to emulate analysis of the 'misspecified model'
simulations in the Chandler et al Ecology paper, assuming removal
sampling. 'um' is a suitable data matrix that seems to import
correctly, but gmultmix falls over:

> dat <- unmarkedFrameGMM(y = um, numPrimary = 1, type = 'removal')
> summary(dat)
unmarkedFrame Object

100 sites
Maximum number of observations per site: 3
Mean number of observations per site: 3
Number of primary survey periods: 1
Number of secondary survey periods: 3
Sites with at least one detection: 55

Tabulation of y observations:
0 1 2 <NA>
225 65 10 0

> fit <- gmultmix(~1, ~1, ~1, data = dat, mixture = 'P', K = 20)
Error in cp[, , R + 1] <- 1 - apply(cp[, , 1:R], 1:2, sum, na.rm =
TRUE) :
number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length

Can anyone see what I'm doing wrong? Better still, is the code for
those simulations posted somewhere?
Thanks
Murray

messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] simple use of gmultmix
parts:
Hi Murray,

That error message says it all no? Just kidding -- I'll add a more informative error message. The issue is that numPrimary must be > 1. If numPrimary=1, you could use multinomPois.

I'll post the simulation script when I get back to the office on Monday.

Richard
